overdrive · regular · 2 days ago · Solution

Switch the linker to psp-ld instead. The binutils 2.43 that ships with modern pspdev emits a .symtab layout that rust-lld strictly rejects. Add this to your .cargo/config.toml:

[target.mipsel-sony-psp]
linker = "/opt/pspdev/bin/psp-ld"
linker-flavor = "gnu"

You'll also need to re-play the target-spec pre-link args and provide a supplementary link script that synthesises _gp, since the rust-psp target script omits it (rust-lld computes it internally).

mipsfan · senior · 1 day ago

Classic FPU ABI mismatch. PSP Allegrex has a single-precision FPU only. rust-psp's target spec declares +single-float, but psp-gcc defaults to -mdouble-float. PPSSPP silently fixes it up; real hardware crashes in the dtoa double-precision helpers.

Set CFLAGS_mipsel_sony_psp_std=-msingle-float in your .cargo/config.toml and rebuild from clean.
